label: Episode 3
logline: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 2's confrontation at the altar, where Juliana publicly exposed Gerald's dishonor before the entire aristocratic congregation.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 3, 1 segment(s), 31s
[01:00.60-01:02.30] LADY JULIANA (Screaming, Resisting): "Let me go!"
[01:02.00-01:03.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.
[01:02.40-01:03.50] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Begging): "Please! Someone!"
[01:03.00-01:04.50] ACTION: The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
[01:03.00-01:04.50] SOUND: Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
[01:04.50-01:06.00] CAMERA: High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
[01:06.00-01:08.10] CAMERA: Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
[01:06.00-01:08.10] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
[01:08.10-01:10.50] CAMERA: Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.
[01:09.90-01:12.10] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Low, Thunderous, Imposing): "Take your hands off her."
[01:10.50-01:12.80] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
[01:12.80-01:15.10] CAMERA: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.
[01:13.00-01:16.80] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching): "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"
[01:15.10-01:17.00] CAMERA: High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
[01:17.00-01:19.00] CAMERA: Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.
[01:17.20-01:18.90] ROYAL GUARD (Aggressive, Threatening): "Stand aside, stranger!"
[01:19.00-01:21.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.
[01:19.30-01:20.90] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Deadly): "I said..."
[01:21.00-01:24.00] CAMERA: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.
[01:21.80-01:23.90] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Dangerous, Uncompromising): "...let her go."
[01:24.00-01:25.50] CAMERA: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
[01:24.00-01:25.50] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
[01:24.50-01:25.40] SOUND: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
[01:25.50-01:28.10] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.
[01:25.60-01:28.00] THE FORMER GROOM (Frantic, Shouting): "What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!"
[01:28.10-01:29.30] CAMERA: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
[01:29.30-01:31.70] CAMERA: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.
[01:30.40-01:31.60] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Gentle, Protective): "Are you hurt?"
[01:31.70-01:31.85] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
[01:31.80-01:31.85] ACTION: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
